summary.headline: APDerm captures $1.18M in annual savings across 12 spend categories; $0.91M already locked in
summary.narrative: Through a two-phase strategic sourcing program with Treya Partners, Adult & Pediatric Dermatology (APDerm) optimized $6.3 million in indirect spend spanning medical supplies, revenue cycle, facilities, logistics and more. The engagement has delivered $907,775 in finalized annual savings across nine categories, while another $272,190 is in the final award or reporting stage. Key wins include a 27% reduction on medical supplies with McKesson, a 17% fee cut with Athenahealth billing services, and a 20% cost drop in janitorial services. Most savings were achieved while retaining incumbent suppliers, minimizing operational disruption.

value_realized_in_days.notes: First finalized savings came with the McKesson medical supplies contract executed 7/30/21, roughly two months after Phase 1 kick-off.

time_to_value.notes: Most Phase 1 categories were implemented within the first quarter of the engagement.

impact.operational_improvements: Standardized supplier contracts across more than 30 clinic locations, leveraged two GPOs (HPG & Premier) for price stability, and instituted ongoing usage tracking for janitorial and copier programs to ensure sustained compliance.

proof_points.statement: Reduced Athenahealth revenue-share fee from 1.80% to 1.50%, unlocking $259,800 in annual savings (17%).
Negotiated McKesson distribution agreement delivering 27% savings ($485K) on medical supplies while locking pricing for 12 months.
Consolidated janitorial services under Enterprise Cleaning with retroactive pricing, cutting costs by $193,565 annually (20%).
